anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Nothing moved on this case: both outputs run the D3 step 4 Exit check first, match the `open - needs src/guard.ts outside the diff` row, exit to `stuck - needs …` without minting a poll deadline, running `gh pr checks --watch`, or re-dispatching the unchanged implementer payload, and both render the obstacle menu as numbered deliver / assess / stop-recommended-last with no fix or wait rows and a deliver line that gates the retry on the prerequisite changing rather than on the cap extension alone. The After wording's batch-summary sequencing change is not exercised here (single PR, numeric argument), so it had no effect; the only drift worth tightening is cosmetic noise in After's deliver row (`+2 x 3; rounds 1 of 6 -> 12`), which is unexplained arithmetic — keep Before's plainer `add 6 to each cap (rounds 1 of 12, syncs 0 of 12)` phrasing, and keep the `gauntlet:` header adjacent to the report block rather than hoisted above the narration, so the per-PR report-and-menu unit stays self-contained when the batch round later renders one PR at a time.
